title: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 1998

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 1998
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998.
ORDINANCE I OF 1998
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission
Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th January, 1998]
No. S. Legis: 1(1)/98, dated
27-1-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:---
1. (1) This Ordinance may
be called the Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Substitution of Section 5-A

ORDINANCE I OF 1998
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998.
ORDINANCE I OF 1998
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission
Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th January, 1998]
No. S. Legis: 1(1)/98, dated
27-1-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:---
2. In the Sindh Public
Service Commission Act, 1989, for section 5-A, the following shall be
substituted:---
"5-A.
Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, Government may, not later than
28th February, 1998, curtail the term of office of the Chairman and members
appointed before coming into force of this section. "
